summary: OpenStreetMap maps a lattice observation tower called Summit Lookout Tower; no lookout register lists it, and no source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Known only from a map entry; no source confirms that a tower stands there.

evidence.supports: Named Summit Lookout Tower on OpenStreetMap
The town of Summit is in Pike County and shares the name
evidence.quote: Summit is a town in Pike County, Mississippi, United States.

evidence.quote: There are 3 former lookout sites registered in Mississippi.

notes_for_editor: Only record is OSM node 357997262 (tags: lattice observation tower; edit comment generic). Not on NHLR or FFLOS Mississippi lists. No historical source found; the story is short for that reason. Pastmaps lists 11 old maps of Summit from 1953 onward (https://pastmaps.com/explore/us/mississippi/pike-county/summit); the tower was not checked on those sheets and they could confirm or refute the record. The brief's 138 m elevation is not confirmed by any source read. anyplaceamerica.com returned 403. The story does not place the tower in the town; no source read links the tower to the town of Summit. Absence checked 2026-10-21: the full NHLR Mississippi list (65 entries) and the FFLOS Mississippi list (3 entries) contain no Summit entry.
